svg.text: Build plan — phases and Claude Code windows

Wide columns: several windows work in parallel, each owning its own directories and building against contracts frozen in Phase 0. Narrow red columns: exactly one Integrator window wires the pieces together. Nobody else commits during integration.
gating for HQ vs store view
Rules that keep windows from colliding: (1) each window edits only its owned directories; (2) shared packages (contracts, db, events, ui) are read-only for everyone except the Architect/Integrator;

(3) every window works on its own branch and opens a PR — nobody merges their own PR; (4) integration weeks freeze all feature branches; (5) a window that needs a contract change files an issue, it does not edit the contract.
